paragraphs.en: Arnold Schwarzenegger, Dia Mirza and Adrian Grenier have a message for you: It's easy to beat plastic. They're part of a bunch of celebrities starring in a new video for World Environment Day – encouraging you, the consumer, to swap out your single-use plastic staples like straws and cutlery to combat the plastics crisis.

paragraphs.en: My concern with leaving it up to the individual, however, is our limited sense of what needs to be achieved. On their own, taking our own bags to the grocery store or quitting plastic straws, for example, will accomplish little and require very little of us. They could even be detrimental, satisfying a need to have “done our bit” without ever progressing onto bigger, bolder, more effective actions – a kind of “moral licensing” that allays our concerns and stops us doing more and asking more of those in charge.

paragraphs.en: It's important to acknowledge that the environment isn't everyone's priority – or even most people's. We shouldn't expect it to be. In her latest book, Why Good People Do Bad Environmental Things, Wellesley College professor Elizabeth R. DeSombre argues that the best way to collectively change the behavior of large numbers of people is for the change to be structural.

sentences.translation: 她说，只是个人行动的进展太慢，不能成为改变广泛存在的行为的唯一办法，甚至不能成为主要办法。

words.meaning: it is缩写：这是；这件事是
引出后面的内容；通常不单译
那种做法（依靠个人行动）
不定式标记，连接后面的动作；不单译
定冠词，限定所说对象；通常不单译
或者（连接可选择的内容）

auditV2.note: too slow for...to个人行动太慢不宜唯一或主要途径，primary非小学，that指个人行动。

paragraphs.en: None of this is about writing off the individual. It's just about putting things into perspective. We don't have time to wait. We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change.

sentences.en: None of this is about writing off the individual.

chunks.en: None of this is about writing off the individual.
chunks.zh: 这一切都不是要否定个人的作用

sentences.reorder: None of this 否定全部前述讨论被解读为否定个人，writing off 按全盘否定译。
sentences.translation: 这一切都不是要否定个人的作用。

words.meaning: 定冠词，限定所说对象；通常不单译

auditV2.note: write off全盘否定个人，None否定该解读，并非取消政策责任。

sentences.en: It's just about putting things into perspective.

chunks.en: It's just about putting things into perspective.
chunks.zh: 只是要从整体上恰当地看待个人行动的作用

sentences.reorder: put...into perspective 指结合全局判断作用，things 按本段话题译明个人行动。
sentences.translation: 只是要从整体上恰当地看待个人行动的作用。

words.meaning: it is缩写：这是；这件事是
放置（put...into perspective结合全局正确看待）
与put...perspective组成放到整体中正确看待

phrases.meaning: 结合整体情况恰当地看待……
结合整体情况恰当地看待……

sentences.en: We don't have time to wait.

chunks.en: We don't have time to wait.

sentences.reorder: 顺译，don't have time 表达紧迫性。
sentences.translation: 我们已经没有时间再等了。

words.meaning: 不定式标记，连接后面的动作；不单译

auditV2.note: have实义有，don't have time无时间可等，紧迫性保留。

sentences.en: We need progressive policies that shape collective action (and rein in polluting businesses), alongside engaged citizens pushing for change.

chunks.en: We need progressive policies
chunks.zh: 我们需要推动进步的政策

chunks.en: that shape collective action
chunks.zh: 引导集体行动

chunks.en: (and rein in polluting businesses),
chunks.zh: 并约束污染企业

chunks.en: alongside engaged citizens pushing for change.
chunks.zh: 同时也需要积极参与、推动变革的公民

sentences.reorder: 先译政策及其两项作用，再译 alongside 并列需要的公民参与，不把政策与公民作替代关系。
sentences.translation: 我们需要推动进步的政策，来引导集体行动并约束污染企业；同时，也需要积极参与、推动变革的公民。

words.meaning: 推动进步的；促进改革的
和；并且（连接并列或承接的内容）
污染（修饰企业）；造成污染

auditV2.note: 政策引导集体行动兼约束污染企业，同时需要参与公民，alongside并非二者替代。

notes: 复核消费者/公民、个人/制度变革之间的论证范围；逐位置改正primary小学、everyone’s缩写、account占比等错误候选，保留报道时点的政策承诺。
